Name: Ranching Tool Upgrades (Pail and Shears)
Author: drbirbdev
Description:
[i][size=5][b]1.6 - No automatic migration happens for existing files.[/b]
[/size][/i][size=3]Make[/size][size=4] sure to delete old tools with the commands and add new tools:
[code]﻿ranch_tools remove_pail
ranch_tools remove_shears
ranch_tools give_pail 1
ranch_tools give_shears 1
[/code]
Replace "1" above with the upgrade level of your tools

4 - iridium
3 - gold
2 - iron
1 - copper
0 - standard


[/size][i][size=4]
Upgrade the Milk Pail and Shears the same way you would other tools.

[/size][/i][list]
[*][size=3]Buy the Milk Pail and Shears from Marnie[/size]
[*][size=3]Visit Clint with some bars to upgrade them[/size]
[*][size=3]Upgrade costs, time, and effects are fully configurable[/size]
[/list]
Upgraded tool effects include
[list]
[*]More animal friendship
[*]Chance of increasing product quality
[*]Chance of getting multiple products from single animal
[/list]
Incompatible with Mail Services Mod.
Not available on Android.

[i][size=4]How To Install

[/size][/i][size=4][size=3]Download, unzip, and place the RanchingToolUpgrades folder into the Stardew Valley Mod folder.

If installing on an existing file where the Milk Pail or Shears have already been bought:
[/size][/size][list]
[*]Just upgrade the existing Milk Pail or Shears at the Blacksmith
[*]If you have previously upgraded the tools using this mod but they don't work, then try removing and re-buying them as mentioned below
[/list]
To uninstall:
[list]
[*]Put Milk Pail and Shears in inventory
[*]Run[font=Courier New][font=Arial] [/font]ranchtools_removepail[/font] to remove the pail
[*]Run [font=Courier New]ranchtools_removeshears[/font] to remove the shears
[*]End the day to save the game
[*]Delete the RanchingToolUpgrades folder from the Stardew Valley Mod folder
[*]Re-buy the Milk Pail and Shears from Marnie after the mod is removed
[/list]
